travel_policy.activation: explicit interaction command within 2.5m, never trigger by arrival overlap
travel_policy.preflight: validate destination configuration/anchor/navigation/collision before replacing current scene; failure keeps old scene and resources
travel_policy.new_link_is_project_adaptation: 游学驿路，不声称小说原文出现泫勃派；旧剧情挑战门仍按原任务条件
travel_policy.save_policy: persist map/anchor context; normal private save restores same attempt, never routes through a public exit/restarts fight

activity_instance_location_rule: private map location requires matching live/persisted attempt; instance ID derived from attempt, not a second independently editable location cache
shop_adapter_policy: authoring refs have explicit known schema adapters; missing price or unsupported adapter fails review, never chooses another field/default zero. P3 exports one formal shop/item configuration, runtime does not interpret prose scopes.
anchor_application_policy: travel/birth/return uses explicit anchor pose; service anchor is only a valid approach example, never teleports player. Actual NPC distance checked from current pose. No missing-yaw default.

legacy_single_map_import.note: explicit mapping for the known single-world old format, not a fallback for unknown/corrupt locations

public_route_design_policy.basis: project adaptation except explicitly sourced NPC location and high-level entry gates
public_route_design_policy.all_class_ids: all 14 classes from 职业创建与成长合同; no class-dependent travel shortcuts
public_route_design_policy.route_access: neutral/righteous/evil may travel both branches; advancement/faction quest eligibility remains owned by task contract
public_route_design_policy.lower_route_gate_choice: level1/rank0 and no quest/item prerequisite on lower trunk routes, including both cave chains; project anti-deadlock choice, not a historical official minimum
public_route_design_policy.fees: every new edge explicitly costs zero silver and no item; official entry consumables for later activities remain out of this graph
public_route_design_policy.npc_identity: each source_reference_id below creates one physical NPC at its actual hosting map, not at the catalog region named by its source page
public_route_design_policy.safe_zone_policy: safe circles forbid hostile spawning/entry, do not restore resources/reset cooldown; monster spawn points must remain outside with actor-radius clearance
public_route_design_policy.boundary_policy: rectangle edges block movement; only explicit interaction connections change map; no exit from falling or touching boundary
public_route_design_policy.lan_policy: host validates every requesting character level/rank/alive/combat/activity independently; party leader cannot move underqualified members; map change preserves party and shared-world identity; destination map populations remain keyed by map_id
out_of_scope: 南明湖/南明洞冲突未裁定，不在本轮合并或增边

回城符种类/来源/价格/使用资格及目标锚待物品合同；不因官方提到回城符而生成免费物品
